literal: Withstanding the vanguard, that which advances is the army, having known the method of withstanding the battle that has come upon them.
translation: A true army is that which, knowing the strategic methods of withstanding an imminent battle, successfully resists the enemy's vanguard and advances.
modern: தனக்கு நேர்ந்த போரை எதிர்கொள்ளும் முறையை அறிந்து, பகைவரின் முன்வரிசைத் தாக்குதலைத் தாங்கி முன்னேறிச் செல்வதே சிறந்த படையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential quality of a true army. A real army is not merely a crowd of soldiers, but a disciplined force that understands the tactical methods of resisting an imminent battle. Armed with this strategic knowledge, it is capable of withstanding the fierce onslaught of the enemy's vanguard and steadily advancing. The word 'தார்' specifically refers to the enemy's front line, and 'தன்மை' denotes the tactical expertise required to counter them.
